name: ai.helixar/mcp
title: Helixar Security
description: Security tools for AI agents: scan MCP servers, validate and verify HDP delegation, audit releases.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: Workers exposes 3 of 4 tools (helixar_inspect_mcp, helixar_hdp_validate, helixar_hdp_verify). The helixar_releaseguard tool wraps a Go binary and is stdio-only.
